question_text: Explain why inconsistent formats, duplicated observations and missing values should be addressed before a dataset is used to train a prediction model.
adaptation_rationale: Retains transformation/cleaning reasoning while replacing ETL implementation detail with required ML data preparation.
solution: Formats must be made consistent so equivalent values are interpreted alike. Duplicate observations can over-weight repeated cases and should be consolidated or removed. Missing values need a justified treatment, such as imputation or deletion, so they do not distort training or cause invalid processing.

marking_points.criterion: Suitable missing-value treatment with relevant purpose.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.
